summary: Round 6 (r6b4): best 98.444 (r6b4_lrg at 18.05B, CP7: the first greedy episode through the -y hole into the room; incumbent 98.349); 0 finishes. Root cause of the last gate (WR demo, measurement only; it replays exactly in our sim): in the basement U-turn the policy strafes 1.5 deg off the velocity (human 0), wall-rides and loses ~300 u/s, so its kick cannot clear the funnel rim.
